---
title: "News & Events"
---

This page can serve as a lightweight editorial stream for the ambassador initiative. It helps the site feel active and gives visitors a reason to return.

## What Belongs Here

- Upcoming webinars and workshops
- New resources added to the library
- Ambassador highlights or interviews
- Calls for participation
- Relevant RDA news for target communities

## Suggested Post Format

Each item can later include:

- Title
- Date
- Type of update
- Short summary
- Link to more information

## Example Entries

### Upcoming Webinar on FAIR Data in Agriculture
Short placeholder summary explaining what the event is, who it is for, and why it matters.

### New Resource Collection for Digital Humanities
Short placeholder summary highlighting what was added and who may benefit from it.

### Community Call for Ambassador Contributions
Short placeholder summary inviting new collaborators, profile updates, or resource suggestions.
